# TestedRoutes

> Printable PDF travel guides built from trips actually taken: an hour-by-hour plan, the bookings that gate the trip, honest costs, and a companion Google map. Skip the research. Take the trip.

TestedRoutes publishes route-level travel guides for people who want a good trip
without spending twenty hours planning it. Each guide is one specific itinerary,
timed end to end, with the reasoning printed alongside the plan: why a stop is on
the route, what it costs in hours, and what was deliberately left out.

What "tested" means here, precisely: the routes are grounded in the founder's own
travel, and every venue, timing, fare and opening hour is verified against the
operator before it ships. It does not mean every listed restaurant or hotel has
been personally slept in or eaten at; alternates are researched and labelled as
such. Where something is uncertain, the guides say so rather than guessing.

How the catalogue is organised:

- **Guides** are the paid product: a PDF plus a companion Google My Maps link.
  Prices run EUR 9-49. The PDF carries the timing, the bookings and the costs.
- **Destinations** are free country hubs: what a country is for, when to go, how
  the guides for it fit together.
- **Inspire** are free first-person stories from the road. They are reporting, not
  itineraries, and they exist to answer the questions people ask before booking.

Editorial notes that matter when citing this site: guides state costs per person
based on two people sharing; durations never count the departure day (eight days
on the ground is a "7 Days" guide); and each guide names one primary pick per
meal and per night, with alternates in a directory rather than in the day plan.

## Guides (paid PDFs)

- [All guides](https://testedroutes.com/guides): the full catalogue with prices and what each covers.
- [Iceland Ring Road: A 7-Day Self-Drive Itinerary](https://testedroutes.com/guides/iceland-ring-road-7-days): the full loop, timed, with a real budget.
- [Iceland South Coast: A 5-Day Self-Drive Itinerary](https://testedroutes.com/guides/iceland-south-coast-5-days): waterfalls, black sand and the glacier lagoon without committing a week.
- [Iceland Layover: Reykjavik and Blue Lagoon in 1 Day](https://testedroutes.com/guides/iceland-layover-reykjavik-blue-lagoon): one curated day between two flights - the Reykjanes loop, the lagoon, and the timing that makes it work.
- [Seychelles: Four Islands in 7 Days](https://testedroutes.com/guides/seychelles-7-days): Mahe, Praslin, La Digue and Curieuse, with the ferry logistics solved.
- [Tuvalu: 2 Days in the World's Least-Visited Country](https://testedroutes.com/guides/tuvalu-2-days): the twice-weekly flight, the runway that is a public square, and what two days there is actually like.
- [Kuwait in 2 Days: A Weekend Itinerary](https://testedroutes.com/guides/kuwait-2-days): the old souk and the dhow harbour in a day, then a Bronze-Age island by boat and the winter desert camps at dusk.
- [Samoa in a Week: Upolu & Savai'i Self-Drive](https://testedroutes.com/guides/samoa-upolu-savaii-7-days): both islands in seven days - To-Sua, the waterfalls, the inter-island ferry crossed the clever way, lava fields and blowholes.
- [Fiji Honeymoon: A 2-Week Itinerary](https://testedroutes.com/guides/fiji-honeymoon-14-days): three Yasawa islands on the hop-on boat pass, the shark dive and the manta channel, then Taveuni's Rainbow Reef - at honeymoon pace.
- [Triftbrucke from Zurich: A Suspension Bridge Day Trip](https://testedroutes.com/guides/trift-bridge-from-zurich): Switzerland's most exposed footbridge as a day trip by train.
- [Simplon Pass to Saas-Fee](https://testedroutes.com/guides/simplon-pass-to-saas-fee): Alpine Passes Trail, 2-day hike.
- [Saas-Fee to Gruben](https://testedroutes.com/guides/saas-fee-to-gruben): Alpine Passes Trail, 2-day hike.
- [Gruben to Grimentz](https://testedroutes.com/guides/gruben-to-grimentz): Alpine Passes Trail, 2-day hike.
- [Grimentz to Evolene](https://testedroutes.com/guides/grimentz-to-evolene): Alpine Passes Trail, 2-day hike.
- [St. Moritz to Alp Flix](https://testedroutes.com/guides/st-moritz-to-alp-flix): Alpine Passes Trail, 2-day hike.
- [Alp Flix to Ausserferrera](https://testedroutes.com/guides/alp-flix-to-ausserferrera): Alpine Passes Trail, 2-day hike.
- [Ausserferrera to Turra](https://testedroutes.com/guides/ausserferrera-to-turra): Alpine Passes Trail, 2-day hike.

## Destinations (free country hubs)

- [All destinations](https://testedroutes.com/destinations): every country covered, and which guides serve it.
- [Iceland](https://testedroutes.com/destinations/iceland): how many days you need, what a week really costs, whether a 4x4 is necessary, and how the Ring Road, south coast and layover guides fit together.
- [Seychelles](https://testedroutes.com/destinations/seychelles): island-hopping, ferries, and which islands are worth the days.
- [Tuvalu](https://testedroutes.com/destinations/tuvalu): the world's least-visited country - getting there via Fiji, what the flight gap gives you, and what two days on Funafuti are actually like.
- [Kuwait](https://testedroutes.com/destinations/kuwait): whether Kuwait is worth visiting, how long you need, why the day of the week matters more than the month, and what the two-day trip costs.
- [Samoa](https://testedroutes.com/destinations/samoa): how many days you need, Upolu vs Savai'i, when to go, and why Sunday shapes the week more than the weather.
- [Fiji](https://testedroutes.com/destinations/fiji): which islands to pick, how long you need, when to go, and how the island-hopping boat system actually works.
- [Switzerland](https://testedroutes.com/destinations/switzerland): the Alpine Passes Trail series and day trips from Zurich.

## Optional

- [Full sitemap](https://testedroutes.com/sitemap.xml): every indexable URL, always current. Prefer this over the lists above when completeness matters.
- The site is built for German, Spanish, French and Lithuanian under a language
  prefix (for example /de/guides), but no translated pages are published yet.
  Everything live today is English at the unprefixed path.
- `/go/*` are short redirect links printed inside the PDFs. They are excluded from
  indexing and carry no content.
